summary: The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in equity securities of U.S. issuers based on the S&P 500 Index (the "index") while hedging overall market exposure by writing (selling) exchange traded call options based on the same securities. Under normal market conditions, it invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities based on the index.
